name: IC Power — buck, 60V — SSOP
description: Surface-mount power IC cluster for 60V buck applications utilizing SSOP footprints.
selection_hints: Select when designing a 60V buck power converter requiring an SMD SSOP package.
Choose for designs matching the SSOP-28_3.9x9.9mm_P0.635mm footprint.
Verify part requirements against available Tier A symbols such as LTC3890-1.
avoid_when: Do not use if the design requires package families other than SSOP.
Avoid if non-SMD or through-hole mounting is required.
Avoid when application topology or voltage differs from a 60V buck IC.
